subject: CAIQ walkthrough + EU data residency proofs and log snapshot plan
messages:
From: Lucia Martinez <lucia@nebulahealth.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: 2026-11-26T09:14:00-05:00
Subject: Request: CAIQ walkthrough + EU data residency proofs

Hi Markus,

I’m Lucia (Security Program Manager at Nebula Health). We’re kicking off our vendor intake for Redwood and would like to schedule a CAIQ walk-through focused on EU data residency and log exportability. Primary goals:
- Confirm where customer data-at-rest is stored for EU tenants (regions/replication).
- Get an example "log snapshot" process and timestamped sample for FRA/Paris region.
- Review retention policy and how we pull syslog/agent data (format + tooling).

Can you do a 60–90 minute session next week? We’re proposing either Tue Nov 30 or Thu Dec 2 (our timezone CET). Attendees will be myself + procurement (Noah Patel).

I’ve attached our initial question list to help triage (nebula_initial_question_list.xlsx). Please let me know which date/time works and who from Redwood should join.

Thanks,
Lucia Martinez
Security Program Manager
Nebula Health

Attachment: nebula_initial_question_list.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Martinez <lucia@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ walkthrough + EU data residency proofs

Hi Lucia — thanks for the note and the spreadsheet. Happy to run this. Proposed approach and logistics:

Agenda (60–75 min):
1) Quick intros + scope (5 min)
2) CAIQ walkthrough (we’ll highlight controls relevant to residency & logging) (20–25 min)
3) Live demo: artifact portal + how we produce log snapshots (20 min)
4) Action items & next steps (10–15 min)

We can do Wed Dec 1 at 14:00 UTC (that’s 15:00 CET) — please confirm if that fits for you and procurement.

Attendees from Redwood: me (product/compliance), Marissa Cole (platform logs & retention), Kimberly Park (security compliance), Laura Bennett (recording/consent + artifacts).

Pre-reads we’ll share ahead of the call: an annotated CAIQ, an example log-snapshot playbook, and our data-residency attestations. Can you confirm whether Nebula needs signed artifacts (e.g., SOC2) or if a CAIQ + attestation is sufficient initially?

I’ve created a shared folder for the intake: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/nebula-caiq/ — I’ll drop the annotated CAIQ and sample log export templates this afternoon.

If Dec 1 doesn’t work, we can do Dec 2 09:00 UTC.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Product Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Lucia Martinez <lucia@nebulahealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Noah Patel <noah.patel@nebulahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:20:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ walkthrough + EU data residency proofs

Thanks Markus — Dec 1 15:00 CET works for us. Noah (procurement) will join to confirm contractual language around residency/replication.

Two additional asks from our technical intake:
- Please include an example of a log export in RFC3339 timestamps and indicate whether we can request point-in-time snapshots for a specific region (we’ll need FRA in particular).
- Can you share your retention schedule (table form) and the accepted log formats for ingestion/pull?

I attached a short SIG focus PDF that outlines the items we’ll prioritize during the call (nebula_sig_focus.pdf) — it’s short.

Looking forward to the call.

Lucia

Attachment: nebula_sig_focus.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lucia Martinez <lucia@nebulahealth.com>, Noah Patel <noah.patel@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: CAIQ walkthrough + EU data residency proofs — Confirmed

Great — confirmed for Tue Dec 1, 2026 at 15:00 CET / 14:00 UTC. Calendar invite will follow. Quick meeting note & action register below so everyone is aligned before the call.

Meeting agenda (final):
- Intros & scope (5)
- CAIQ annotated review (20)
- Live demo: artifact portal + how to request log snapshots (20)
- Q&A: retention, format, export windows (15)
- Action items and next steps (10)

Action items (owners):
- Marissa Cole: prepare a log-snapshot playbook (examples: timeframe, regional endpoints, sample output) and one FRA-specific sample (deliver drop to shared drive).
- Kimberly Park: provide annotated CAIQ (controls called out for residency/retention) and SOC2 summary if needed.
- Laura Bennett: coordinate recording consent and set up artifact drop permissions for Nebula.
- Markus Klein: provide meeting agenda, share HubSpot intake record, and confirm whether procurement requires contractual language or a signed attestation ahead of the call.

Deliverables we’ll upload to the shared folder before the meeting: caiq-annotated-template.xlsx, log-snapshot-instructions.pdf, data-residency-attestation.pdf (if needed).

HubSpot intake: https://hubspot.redwood.com/record/HUB-5321
Doc signing link (procurement): https://docusign.net/links/nebula-data-residency

Attachments included: log-snapshot-instructions.pdf, caiq-annotated-template.xlsx

Markus
Head of Product Compliance
Redwood Inference

Thanks — I’ll own the FRA log pull. I’ll coordinate with infra to reserve a snapshot window for 2026-12-28 (UTC) and aim to upload the sample to the shared drive by 2026-12-29.

Note: infra asked whether Nebula needs raw syslog (RFC5424) or pre-parsed JSON lines; Lucia — please confirm preference in the call so we provide the right sample.

Will update the action register once the snapshot window is booked.

—Marissa
Platform Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
